objective: Evaluate the exact frozen H2SAFE orientation-class detector rank candidate against per-sensor spatial responses from 18 public actual-hydrogen HyTunnel experiments without fitting coordinates, amplitudes, alarm thresholds or rank coefficients.
claim_boundary: This holdout tests spatial rank transfer only in one mechanically ventilated enclosure with a vertically downward source. It does not validate concentration amplitude, alarm or trip setpoints, outdoor station detector placement, CFD, ESD, consequence distance or a complete station-to-vehicle loop.

prior_access.classification: MODEL_FROZEN_RAW_SPATIAL_ENDPOINT_PREACCESS; not a fully byte-blinded or pre-download study

excluded_experiments.1: No Exp01.mat is present in dataset version 1.1.
excluded_experiments.2: No Exp02.mat is present in dataset version 1.1.
excluded_experiments.3: The public article identifies Exp3 as nonrepresentative.
excluded_experiments.17: The public article identifies Exp17 as nonrepresentative.
excluded_experiments.18: The public article identifies Exp18 as nonrepresentative.

coordinate_lock.model_mapping: Point3D(x/1000, y/1000, z/1000), with Y as elevation
coordinate_lock.source_basis: The article places the downward nozzle 5000 mm from the ventilation wall and 250 mm above the floor; z=0 is the published table centre-line coordinate used by the under-table sensor layout.

locked_extraction.sensor_pairing: Preserve MATLAB cell-array order across ID, position, time and concentration.
locked_extraction.response_window: Every finite S.conc value whose paired S.time is at or after MFM.t0.
locked_extraction.per_sensor_response: q99(S.conc) minus q10(S.conc) over the frozen response window
locked_extraction.sensor_subset_selection: prohibited except documented missing or fewer-than-30-sample channels

per_case.rank_statistic: Spearman rho between frozen geometry score and robust per-sensor response
per_case.top5_recall: fraction of the five highest-scored sensors contained in the observed top response quartile
per_case.nearest_success: highest-scored sensor is in the observed top response quartile
per_case.tie_break: ascending sensor ID after descending score or response

aggregate_decision.runtime_candidate_enabled_on_pass: only after audit verifies model hash, case completeness, unchanged protocol and all screens
